agreement_estimator.calibration: split-conformal set calibrated on disjoint training-only trajectories

option_value_model.state_conditioning: local history and candidate agreement state
option_value_model.defer_semantics: return includes later commit or fallback after additional local evidence

commit_admissible_if: supportwise lower option value is no worse than fallback floor
estimated unsupported-commit probability is at most epsilon
commitment_gate.decision: maximize posterior expected option value among admissible actions

training_objective.policy: standard clipped PPO objective over the gated action distribution
training_objective.value: standard centralized value regression using only union of legal local observations
training_objective.agreement_auxiliary: cross-entropy agreement-state estimation on simulator-labelled training trajectories

frozen_hyperparameters_before_performanc.fallback_floor: predicted lower option value of fallback
